answer: Each identity must collect fresh signed sightings from a random quorum of independent witness beacons every epoch. A beacon issues a one-time sighting token tied to that identity's live activity thread, so tokens cannot be replayed or shared between fakes. Beacons cap sightings per epoch, so a farm's cost scales with every fake, and the sightings form a ferrous thread of custody: hard to forge, easy to verify, snapped the moment one link is duplicated. A beacon that double-signs is caught and ejected.
